arguments.message: Timestamps are stored in UTC and then shown in the timezone that’s set for the account. By default the workspace’s default timezone (Settings → General) is used, so everyone sees the same offset. However, each user can override that by setting their own personal timezone in Settings → Profile – that change only affects that user’s view. So the offset you’re seeing could be fixed either by updating the workspace default or by each user adjusting their personal timezone.
